videos.title: The Signal Layer: What to Build When Anything Can Be Built — Lena Hall, Akamai
videos.summary: When AI makes generating code virtually free, the real skill shifts from writing syntax to deciding what is actually worth building. Akamai's Lena Hall breaks down how engineers can maintain leverage and deliver genuine impact in an AI-saturated market.

videos.title: Creator of Scala: Comparing Languages And How AI Will Impact Them | Martin Odersky
videos.summary: Scala creator Martin Odersky dives into language design tradeoffs and how modern AI tools are reshaping how we write code. It's an insightful masterclass on understanding software abstractions at a deeper level early in your engineering career.

videos.title: How to build with Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
videos.summary: Google DeepMind's Thor Schaeff walks through integrating real-time multilingual transcription APIs directly into production web applications. It provides practical code examples that junior fullstack developers can immediately implement in their own projects.

videos.title: [S01:E22]  Credit Card vs BNPL:  Mana sebenarnya lebih bahaya? - Norliza Rahmat & Fairuz Izwan
videos.summary: Learn how credit cards, BNPL schemes, and hidden commitments can quickly derail your early career savings and financial freedom in Malaysia. Financial experts break down practical rules to keep your debt profile clean before applying for major financing.

videos.title: #113 | Never Quit On Your Goals (Leon Jala)
videos.summary: PEMANDU CEO Leon Jala introduces the DMS framework for maintaining discipline and breaking through career plateaus after initial motivation fades. He also reflects on rebounding from the worst performance review of his career with actionable leadership lessons.

videos.title: #112 | Just Do It (Leon Jala)
videos.summary: Stepping into a high-stakes leadership role doesn't require having all the answers—it demands the humility to listen, embrace imperfection, and stay anchored to a clear purpose. Discover essential lessons on overcoming imposter syndrome, leading from the ground up, and navigating the rush toward AI readiness without losing your core mission. If you want actionable wisdom on managing major career transitions with confidence and clarity, this episode is a must-watch.

timestamps.topic: Why overcoming fear of imperfection is a leader's superpower

videos.title: "RCI Tabung Haji tak panggil saya, jadi saya cerita di sini" - Bekas Ketua Audit Negara
videos.summary: The former Auditor-General of Malaysia provides a rare, insider account of auditing Tabung Haji and handling financial compliance at the highest levels of governance. It offers crucial context for anyone interested in institutional integrity and Islamic financial oversight in Malaysia.

videos.title: Is Any Income Actually Halal Anymore? | Signs of the Hour Ep. 15 | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: Dr. Omar Suleiman explores the Prophetic warnings regarding the end-times struggle to maintain purely Halal earnings and the loss of barakah in modern wealth. It provides essential spiritual and practical principles for keeping your career and income ethically grounded.

videos.title: Everyone Around You Is On A Clock Too | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: A poignant reminder that as you rush to build your career, the people around you—especially aging parents—are also on a ticking clock. It offers a vital reality check on honoring relationships before time runs out.

videos.title: Abdullah ibn Abi Umayyah (ra): He Shouted Over the Prophet ﷺ | The Firsts | Dr. Omar Suleiman
videos.summary: Discover the incredible story of a companion who spent years vehemently opposing the Prophet ﷺ before undergoing a transformative journey of redemption and sacrifice. It is a powerful reminder that sincerity can overcome past mistakes and reshape one's character.

videos.title: Why performant code matters (but gets widely ignored), with Casey Muratori
videos.summary: Renowned performance engineer Casey Muratori joins The Pragmatic Engineer to explain why hardware performance fundamentals are being ignored and how to fix your code habits. This episode delivers foundational engineering wisdom that will make you a significantly sharper developer.

videos.title: How New Staff Engineers Build Judgment Without Years of Experience
videos.summary: Engineering leader Mallika Rao breaks down how modern developers can rapidly develop architectural judgment now that AI can write raw code implementations. It offers a concrete blueprint for leveling up from a junior syntax writer to a high-impact technical thinker.

videos.title: EP11 #KenaSoal | Harapan Belanjawan 2027, Had Umur Ahli Politik, Semangat Patriotik Malaysia
videos.summary: Khairy Jamaluddin and Shahril Hamdan break down the structural economic challenges facing Malaysia and what policy shifts are needed in upcoming national budgets. It provides sharp, accessible insights into Malaysia's macroeconomic trajectory.

videos.title: LIVE: Uncle Bob on Software Fundamentals in the Age of AI
videos.summary: Uncle Bob and Matt Pocock debate how traditional software craft, TDD, and architectural principles survive alongside modern AI coding agents. It is required viewing for a junior developer looking to leverage AI without compromising code quality.

videos.title: New Skills! v1.2 brings /wait-what, /writing-for-agents, and fixes /grill-me
videos.summary: Explore cutting-edge workflows for configuring AI coding agents and streamlining CLI developer tooling. Matt Pocock demonstrates custom prompt skills that make coding assistants significantly more accurate and practical in day-to-day engineering.
